card.name: Literary history before author names
card.fires_on: Linking words and commas just before a famous writer's name in essays on English or French literature and poets, such as Tennyson, Pope, Boileau or Strachey.

modes.description: A comma, preposition or similar word right before the name of a poet or author in a literary essay.
